rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCPX is a control plane and proxy server for Model Context Protocol implementations, built by Lunar.dev using TypeScript and React. It acts as an intermediary layer that aggregates multiple MCP servers, provides centralized management through a web-based control plane, and offers features like tool access controls, session management, metrics collection, and Docker-based server orchestration. The implementation includes a comprehensive UI for monitoring system connectivity, managing server configurations, and analyzing usage patterns, along with WebSocket-based real-time communication between components. It serves organizations needing centralized MCP infrastructure management, developers building complex multi-server MCP deployments, and teams requiring observability and access control over their MCP tool ecosystem without managing individual server instances manually.
